subGoals.rule: One command changes and keeps one aggregate instance; a brew changes the batch only, and the ingredient lots follow through the kept batch-brewed fact (Vernon P4).
The best-before and enough-left rules belong to the ingredient lot, and the minimum fermentation rule belongs to the batch; neither is decided outside the domain (Vernon P4).

precedent: clean only: both stores post the facts a change raised to the mailbox in the same step, and the relay hands them to reactions after each command (the goods-in book line on lot-received).
